import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import type { LingzhiGuideStep } from '@src/api/schemas/lingzhi-guide';
import App from '@src/response-apps/profession/joinLingzhi/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const LINGZHI_GUIDE_CONTINUE_COMMAND = '/继续灵药指引';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await App({ bid, uid, messageText: e.MessageText, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (result.code === 'INVALID_USER') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('未找到角色数据，请先踏入仙途。');
      sendGuideMessage({ message, bid, isPrivate, content: md });

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'GUIDE_COMPLETED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('🌿 灵药师指引完成！');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('你俯身拢土，灵息顺着掌心沉入田垄，洞府中的第一缕草木生机自此扎根。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('从今日起，这方灵田便归你照料。记得常来浇灌、除虫、收割，草木也会回报你的耐心。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      sendGuideMessage({
        message,
        bid,
        isPrivate,
        title: '灵药师指引',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '灵田', command: '/灵田' },
          { label: '我的职业', command: '/我的职业' }
        ]
      });

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'FAIL') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();
      const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

      md.addText(repeatMsg);
      sendGuideMessage({ message, bid, isPrivate, title: '灵药师指引', content: md });

      return;
    }

    if (result.code !== 'SHOW_STEP') {
      throw new Error('LINGZHI_GUIDE_UNEXPECTED_RESULT');
    }

    showGuideStep({
      step: result.data.step,
      message,
      bid,
      isPrivate
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('灵药师指引失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('灵药师指引处理失败，请稍后重试。');
    sendGuideMessage({ message, bid, isPrivate, title: '灵药师指引', content: md });
  }
});

function showGuideStep(params: { step: LingzhiGuideStep; message: any; bid: string; isPrivate: boolean }) {
  const { step, message, bid, isPrivate } = params;

  switch (step) {
    case 1: {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('🌿 灵药师指引');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('洞府石门轻启，潮润灵气扑面而来。青苔沿石阶生长，一片荒置药圃静卧在微光之下。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('灵植执事俯身捻起一撮泥土，缓声道：“灵药师修的不是锋芒，而是草木生机。先学会认田，才能种出真正有灵性的药材。”');
      sendGuideMessage({
        message,
        bid,
        isPrivate,
        title: '灵药师指引',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '继续', command: LINGZHI_GUIDE_CONTINUE_COMMAND }]
      });

      break;
    }

    case 2: {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('🪴 识田');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('“灵田最怕两件事：一是根基不稳，二是心浮气躁。”执事抬手指向田垄，“田分品阶，草木有性，浇灌、除虫、除草、收割，皆要按节气与状态来做。”');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('“你日后照看的，不只是几株药草，而是一条长期供养修行的资源线。”');
      sendGuideMessage({
        message,
        bid,
        isPrivate,
        title: '灵药师指引',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '继续', command: LINGZHI_GUIDE_CONTINUE_COMMAND }]
      });

      break;
    }

    case 3: {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('🧰 领工具');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('执事将一柄灵锄放到你手中，又取来几枚聚灵草种。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('“洞府灵田开启后，你便能亲手开垦、播种与照料。先把这套流程记住，往后每天顺手经营，积少成多，远胜一时冲动。”');
      sendGuideMessage({
        message,
        bid,
        isPrivate,
        title: '灵药师指引',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '继续', command: LINGZHI_GUIDE_CONTINUE_COMMAND }]
      });

      break;
    }

    case 4: {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('✅ 准备开启灵田');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('执事轻轻点头：“去吧，从今日起，你便以灵药师身份照料洞府灵田。先把田开起来，再谈后面的草木之道。”');
      sendGuideMessage({
        message,
        bid,
        isPrivate,
        title: '灵药师指引',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '完成指引', command: LINGZHI_GUIDE_CONTINUE_COMMAND }]
      });

      break;
    }

    default: {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('未知的灵药师指引步骤。');
      sendGuideMessage({ message, bid, isPrivate, title: '灵药师指引', content: md });
    }
  }
}

function sendGuideMessage(params: {
  message: any;
  bid: string;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  title?: string;
  content: ReturnType<typeof Format.createMarkdown>;
  footer?: Array<{ label: string; command: string }>;
}) {
  const { message, bid, isPrivate, title = '', content, footer = [] } = params;

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title,
      content,
      footer
    })
  );
}
